tv_wonder_pharos_alexandria_hostile_privateers_trigger = {
	location:alexandria = {
		sea_zone = {
			area = {
				any_privateer_in_area = {
					NOT = { owner = root }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_controlled_trigger = {
	owns = location:constantinople
}

tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_has_owner_trigger = {
	location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes }
}

tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_basing_trigger = {
	location:constantinople = {
		has_owner = yes
		owner = {
			gives_fleet_basing_rights_to = root
			receives_fleet_basing_rights_from = root
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_pending_trigger = {
	NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_route_constantinople_passed }
}

tv_wonder_pharos_route_selected_constantinople_trigger = {
	has_variable = tv_wonder_pharos_active_route
	var:tv_wonder_pharos_active_route ?= 1
}
